facts: Serves as the exclusive Gateway to CodeReborn's knowledge base via REST API / FastAPI.
It implements 6 primary operation domains: Project Understanding, Structural Navigation, Task Context Building, Change Impact, Documentation Access, and Guided Intelligence.
Does not edit code. Does not manipulate files directly.
rules: API Endpoints MUST implement 100 requests / minute rate-limiting per Job ID to intercept abuse.
APIs MUST use Bearer Token JWT authentication.
Endpoints operating in Domains 3 (Task Context), 4 (Impact) and 6 (Guided Intelligence) MUST invoke the LLMBudgetService because they are dynamic inference endpoints.
boundaries: The FastAPI application MUST be decoupled entirely from the background Celery Workers processing the CrewAI pipelines.
The Repo Intelligence Interface MUST NOT block or halt operations awaiting background jobs; it responds strictly based on what is available in PostgreSQL at call-time.
extension_points: Future UI frontends, MCP protocols, and VSCode/Cursor extensions will easily bind to the REST interface natively to construct local contextual prompts.
patterns: Read-Optimized Queries directly pulling materialized JSONB documents.
Dynamic RAG emulation utilizing LLMs for cross-referencing pre-calculated Architecture trees.
anti_patterns: Triggering full-repo scans directly on HTTP GET requests.
Bypassing the LLMBudgetService for HTTP ad-hoc LLM consultations.
conventions: Use Dependency Injection in FastAPI to fetch the LLMBudgetService dynamically.
Return JSON objects natively using Pydantic modeling.
constraints: Timeout limits on synchronous Guided Intelligence endpoints MUST be strictly enforced (Fail-fast paradigm).
